title: Product Manager
description:
WHO WE ARE

OneCrew is building the dominant platform in paving and asphalt - a rapidly digitizing and consolidating industry that's been too long overlooked. Our product spans the heart of our customers' operations: mapping, estimating, contracting, scheduling, invoicing, job costing, and integrations.

At OneCrew we're building something special. If you want to build the AI product function of a company transforming a massive, underserved industry - and you love to grind toward simple, powerful solutions - we want to hear from you.

 

THE ROLE

We're looking to hire our second product person to help us:

1. Capitalize on strong PMF by constantly improving our killer features

2. Accelerate and refine product operations to get great products to our customers quickly and smoothly

3. Help build an AI product function from the ground up

You'll work directly with our product lead and co-founders on the future of OneCrew. You'll get a front-row seat (and a hand on the wheel) at a growing startup serving critical construction businesses. This is a role for someone who loves solving problems and using AI to move faster each day.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Talk to customers, understand the root of their problems, and ship efficient solutions.

- Build AI-powered product-operations loops - using agents and evals to automate discovery, analysis, QA, and the day-to-day of running product.

- Develop our product-led growth motion - self-serve feature, activation, and expansion loops that grow ACV.

- Define success metrics, analyze usage data to find trends and opportunities, and lead launches with sales, CS, and marketing.

- Help shape OneCrew's AI features as we build agentic workflows across our platform.

WHO YOU ARE

- Early-to-mid career and hungry - you're looking for an environment to truly maximize your impact and grow ridiculously fast. You're an excellent manager of yourself, and you consider feedback on your work and performance a gift - never something to avoid.

- Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-paced startup - you close loops and finish what you start.

- Strong writer and communicator who can align engineers, designers, and go-to-market partners around both the vision and the details. You're constantly developing your ability to influence.

- Systems thinker - you’re always looking for patterns, models, and relationships.

- AI-first in how you work and think: you reach for agents, evals, and automation loops by default, and you have opinions about where they help and where they don't.

- Highly analytical - able to take in quantitative and qualitative information and make fast, data-driven decisions while keeping customer empathy front and center.

- You're already a power user of Claude Code, Google Sheets, and Figma. You can lead a conversation on both modal interface design and MCPs.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 2-3 years of product management or adjacent background (startup operations, consulting, design, or SWE) with demonstrated ability flexing across strategy, analytics, design, and coding.

- Understanding of software development fundamentals including agentic coding.

- Understanding of marketing fundamentals, product-led and sales-led growth motions.

- Track record of working on products that solved real problems and moved a metric.

- Strong plus: hands-on fluency with AI feature development - you've built an agent, not just used one.

- Strong plus: A background in software for SMBs, construction, field-service, or internal workflows.

WHAT WE OFFER

- A great environment to grow, learn, and do your best work at a fun, fast-paced startup.

- Unlimited PTO.

- Full medical, dental, and vision coverage (100%-covered options available).

- Office perks: breakfast, weekly lunch, monthly team events.

description:

This position offers you the opportunity to work in a project team environment with other engineers and designers involved in the detailed electrical design and project management of high voltage substation projects. As a Senior Substation Engineer, you will:

title: Director of Engineering, Frontend technologies, Marketplace Technologies
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

About the Role

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Frontend Technologies domain within Marketplace. In this role, your mission will be two-fold: 

• Pivot our frontend setup for bigger efficiency : we have been operating in mostly the same frontend setup for at least 6 years, and recognize that change is imminent.

• Drive strategic engineering initiatives : architect and implement platform-specific changes that enhance modularity, autonomy, resilience, and performance across Android, iOS, and Web. 

You will have to balance and prioritize foundational capabilities - such as Design Systems, CI/CD, Modularization, App Releases, Performance, and Global UI quality - to optimize both frontend developer velocity and user satisfaction.

You will lead 4 Engineering Managers and 3 Staff Engineers and set and implement the FE strategy, which will impact the roadmaps of 9 Product domains within the Marketplace.

In this position, you will

Strategically:

• Ensure the most effective frontend setup for the Marketplace. We have 40+ teams, each with 3 frontend engineers (iOS, Android, and Web) in the Marketplace unit. We know this will look different in two years. Deciding what different means, and getting 9 product domains to fund it, is the job

• Drive Technology Strategy: Set and drive the future technology strategy for frontends, establishing a modular, scalable architecture that enables rapid development and strategic growth. Basically - raise the technological bar for all Marketplace unit. 

• Refine the domain's identity: Take sole ownership of shaping its future, successfully integrating Design Systems and engineering to treat our frontend platforms as a cohesive product.

Tactically : 

• Lead frontends: Lead a horizontal, platform-focused domain containing Android, iOS, Web, and Design System teams.

• Lead Initiatives: Oversee Marketplace-wide technical tooling, core libraries, and frameworks. Lead strategic projects, i.e., frontend modularization and modernization (SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose), native automated testing.

• Elevate global UI quality: Integrate design systems and accessibility into the frontend ecosystem to consolidate technical, visual and interaction quality standards. Support UI experimentation.

• Ensure Resilience & Reliability: Maintain robust release processes, Marketplace frontend quality, and performance monitoring to reduce downtime and ensure a consistent member experience.

• Innovate & Optimize: Drive AI-efficiency enablement in frontend dev

title: Software Engineer (Ray Core)
description:
About Anyscale:

At Anyscale https://www.anyscale.com/, we're on a mission to democratize distributed computing and make it accessible to software developers of all skill levels. We’re commercializing Ray https://docs.ray.io/en/latest/, a popular open-source project that's creating an ecosystem of libraries for scalable machine learning. Companies like OpenAI https://thenewstack.io/how-ray-a-distributed-ai-framework-helps-power-chatgpt/, Uber https://www.uber.com/blog/horovod-ray/, Spotify https://engineering.atspotify.com/2023/02/unleashing-ml-innovation-at-spotify-with-ray/, Instacart https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3t26ucTy0Rs&list=PLzTswPQNepXmLUiL4F_1VHrPcCz1OeILw&index=23&pp=iAQB, Cruise https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gj0BqvfX_wI&list=PLzTswPQNepXmLUiL4F_1VHrPcCz1OeILw&index=46&pp=iAQB, and many more, have Ray in their tech stacks to accelerate the progress of AI applications out into the real world.

With Anyscale, we’re building the best place to run Ray, so that any developer or data scientist can scale an ML application from their laptop to the cluster without needing to be a distributed systems expert.

Proud to be backed by Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, and Addition https://www.wsj.com/articles/ai-startup-anyscale-adds-99-million-to-andressen-horowitz-led-funding-round-11661254200 with $250+ million raised to date.

About the role

Ray aims to provide a universal API for building distributed applications. To achieve this goal requires a distributed system with high levels of performance and reliability. We're looking for engineers with systems software experience that are interested in contributing to the Ray backend.

About the Ray Core Team

The Ray Core team develops and maintains the Ray C++ backend (e.g., distributed scheduler, language runtime integration, I/O and memory subsystems). We are responsible for the reliability, scalability, and performance of Ray as well as ensuring that Ray provides the right feature set to support higher level libraries and use cases. The team works on a balance of new features / distributed libraries, test infra improvements, debugging, and longer-term architectural improvements to Ray.

A snapshot of projects you can work on:

- Optimizing performance of large-scale workloads on Ray

- Stability and stress testing infrastructure

- Improving fault tolerance (HA)

As part of this role, you will:

- Leading cross-team projects while mentoring junior team members

- Develop high quality open source software to simplify distributed programming (Ray)

- Identify, implement, and evaluate architectural improvements to Ray core

- Improve the testing process for Ray to make releases as smooth as possible

- Communicate your work to a broader audience through talks, tutorials, and blog posts

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

- At least 5 year of relevant work experience

- Experience in building scalable and fault-tolerant distributed systems

- Extensive experience working in C/C++ and on low level operating systems

- Solid background in algorithms, data structures, system design

- Knowledge of distributed model training and inference (e.g. tensor parallel, pipeline parallel) is preferred

- Knowledge of GPU programming is preferred

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About the role
Data science is in a moment of reinvention: AI-generated code and agentic workflows are changing what it means to put analytical work into production. Posit’s mission is to empower people to conduct trustworthy data analysis for themselves, their organizations, and the world at large. Posit Team is the trusted on-premises platform at the center: a place where data scientists and the organizations that rely on them can explore data, deploy applications and agents, expose and consume MCP servers, and do all of it with the visibility, accountability, and reproducibility that serious analytical work demands.
We are seeking a skilled Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will bring a builder’s instinct to a team working at the intersection of data science, infrastructure, and AI. You will help us build new capabilities and features in our product suite, including things we haven’t yet imagined possible, and you will drive those changes forward into our customers’ hands.
About you
You are an enthusiastic generalist who thrives in the face of ambiguous requirements-an engineer who is just as good at starting things as you are at finishing them. Some qualities we value most:
High agency
You are driven. When something important feels daunting or underspecified, your first instinct is to prototype to clarify the value you can deliver, rather than wait for someone to give you the answers.
Boldness in learning
You are genuinely unafraid to tackle unfamiliar subjects. You know that nobody is an expert in everything, and you don't let unfamiliarity be a reason for not trying. You're not afraid to ask questions and make mistakes, because learning new techniques feels like an adventure and we share what we learn as a team. Proficiency in either Go or Typescript as well as in either Python or R, and experience with backend systems, data tooling, and data science frameworks are helpful for this role. Eagerness and boldness to learn is essential.
User empathy and product sense
You make judgment calls on behalf of users with minimal up front guidance and are willing to be wrong, because you will learn. Prior domain expertise with data science as a practice may help, but it is not the only way. Regardless, you lead with empathy: you optimize for solving a real customer problem, not for technical purity.
Collaborative curiosity
You are generous. When you learn something useful, your first instinct is to share it. You teach as readily as you learn, ask questions without ego, admit what you don't know, and lend a hand when someone's stuck.
Interest in AI
You are interested not just in using AI in your work, but building tools for customers to use AI in their own work. You also are curious, and you question when AI is not the right answer for a particular problem. You lean on your user empathy when building: knowing that some of our customers use and love AI in data science and others don’t or are restricted from using it.
Results-driven
You are focused on delivering measurable value to customers. You have a strong technical background with a track record of shipping successful products.
Within one week, you will…

• Ship code changes that meaningfully improves the experience for our customers.
Within one month, you will…

• See your changes reflected in our public releases.

• Participate in feature planning and provide feedback.

• Feel comfortable navigating the codebase and understand how things fit together.

Within three months, you will…

• Plan features and drive their development.

• Have a track record of teaching team members; both from your expertise and things you learn as you build.

• Have a track record of learning: both from the things you learned and taught us along the way; and from listening to internal users, external users, and how our customers use our products.

Within six months, you will…

• Point to new features you built that we hadn’t even dreamed were possible.

More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries - from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The Opportunity 🚀

Carrot is expanding its telemedicine clinic with a network of part-time to full-time, fully remote Registered Nurses who deliver evidence-based virtual care to members across all U.S. states. As an RN in this network, you are often the first clinical touchpoint for members navigating fertility, menopause, hormonal, and metabolic health journeys, providing triage, education, care coordination, and documentation that shape the entire care experience.

All work in this role is performed within RN scope of practice. RNs provide triage, education, care coordination, and documentation; they do not diagnose, do not prescribe, and do not independently modify a treatment plan. Anything requiring clinical judgment beyond RN scope is routed to a physician, so sound escalation judgment is central to the role.

• Contributed to chart audits, protocol feedback, and quality improvement as the telemedicine program scales.

This portfolio is the majority of Hightouch's revenue - and it deserves a single, dedicated owner. Audiences, traits, experiments, analytics, and orchestration are the surfaces our customers live in every day, but the unifying vision across them has so far been carried by founders and shared across the team. We need someone who can drive clarity, set prioritization, and bring a unifying vision across that entire portfolio.

A significant part of the job will be deciding what to prioritize and what outcomes to achieve in which order to hit our company revenue goals. Some examples include:

• Building 0→1 in global orchestration: defining the right audience, campaign and journey primitives for AI-native, Fortune 100-class marketing programs

title: Senior Software Engineer, Cortex Quality
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Cortex Code is Snowflake’s coding agent for building with data. It ships inside the platform that thousands of the world’s largest enterprises - including a large share of the Forbes Global 2000 - run their data on, which means the quality of this agent is felt by the data teams behind a meaningful slice of the global economy. We are taking coding agents from impressive demos to tools Data Science and Engineering teams depend on every day, and we hold them to a rigorous, public bar.

See our data engineering agent benchmark https://www.snowflake.com/en/blog/engineering/data-eng-bench-data-engineering-agent-benchmark/.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a measurement-first role that owns the quality and efficiency of Cortex Code end to end: how good the agent is, how much it costs to run, and how reliably it behaves in production. You will take agents from research capability to real, measurable user value - turning fuzzy “the agent feels worse” signals into hard metrics, running the experiments that move them, and shipping the changes that stick. You will work on a small, high-powered modeling and infrastructure team where your work reaches every developer building on Snowflake.

WHAT YOU WILL DO IN THIS ROLE

- Take agents from prototype to production: design and refine agent behaviors for real coding and data-engineering workflows, and make them reliable enough to depend on.

- Own agent quality end to end: build eval harnesses, diagnose failure modes from real agent trajectories, and run experiments that hillclimb the metrics that matter.

- Drive down cost and latency without regressing quality: prompt caching, context compaction, tool-result offloading, and cheaper model routing for sub-tasks. At Snowflake scale, efficiency is user value.

- Debug production failures and systematically increase robustness: close the loop from a customer’s broken run back to a fix and a regression test.

- Build the data pipelines that feed real-world task insights back into evals and modeling.

- Onboard and bake off frontier models: measure their strengths and failure modes, and decide where each belongs in the product.

- Partner with product and infra: shape user-facing agent behavior, and set the metrics and standards that define a successfully completed complex task.

REQUIREMENTS

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field. Master’s or higher preferred but not a requirement.

- 6+ years of experience shipping software in production, including AI/LLM features.

- Fluency in at least one of Python, TypeScript, or Go, and willingness to work across all three

- A measurement-first, systems-thinking instinct: you optimize for user outcomes over isolated metrics, and you can design an eval that is not fooling you (sampling, ground-truth quality, leakage, noise).

- Comfort debugging complex, unpredictable, real-world failures.

- Strong communication skills: you can make a quality or cost result legible to engineers, product, and leadership, and collaborate effectively in a team environment.

NICE TO HAVE

- Deep hands-on experience with agentic coding tools and real intuition for model strengths, failure modes, and prompting limits.

- Prior work on eval harnesses, LLM observability, or safety/guardrails in prod

Who we are
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
Why South Africa
South Africa has one of the strongest engineering communities anywhere in the world, and we are deliberately growing our technology organisation in the country. We already have several team members based here. The work is fully remote, and the mission we are working on is a good deal closer to home than it is for our teams elsewhere.
So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Rewards to join us in South Africa.
About The Role
Rewards is one of the most strategically important platforms at Moniepoint , and it is being built into a dedicated charter with its own engineering and product leadership. The platform sits at the centre of our retention strategy across a user base of approximately 23 million people.
Today the platform does one thing: cashback. It works, but it has barely scratched the surface of what rewards can be, and the cashback product itself is not yet built to the depth it deserves. The ambition is to evolve it into a full rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform - and to do that across the full 360 degrees of our network. That means rewards for our business customers, rewards for our consumer customers, and rewards for the sales agents who drive our distribution. Very few companies get to design this from close to a blank page at this scale.
The Head of Engineering owns that platform end to end. You will inherit a team of nine engineers, including an Engineering Manager, and build the organisation out from there - the current expectation is a minimum of three product units and upwards of 25 people, though the eventual shape is genuinely yours to define. Your first objective is to get the best possible performance out of the cashback product we already have. Rewards is won or lost on experimentation, personalisation, and the quality of the experience in a customer's hands. We are looking for a leader who has built and shipped direct-to-consumer products at scale, who is fluent in experimentation and A/B testing, and who has real depth in front-end and mobile engineering - not a purely backend platform leader.
Moniepoint runs a Domain CTO model. We view our Heads of Engineering as the CTO of their domain: you own the technical roadmap, the architecture, the delivery, and the organisation beneath you. You will have full autonomy over engineering strategy, architecture, hiring, operating cadence and roadmap trade-offs.
You will report functionally to our Group CTO, with a dual reporting line into the Product leader for Rewards. That second line is a delivery relationship rather than a seniority one - engineering and product are peers here, and you will build the team to full capacity together. Your responsibilities as Head of Engineering, Rewards includes:

• Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Rewards Platform end to end.

• Improving the performance, reliability and depth of the existing cashback product as an immediate first priority.

• Evolving cashback into a broader rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform serving business customers, consumer customers and sales agents.

description:
About Hightouch

Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.

At Hightouch , our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient - and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.

About the Role
We are looking for an engineering leader to work on Customer Studio, Hightouch ’s second major product that provides a purpose-built no-code suite of features that enables anyone, regardless of their SQL experience, to activate data directly from their warehouse. The product has grown extremely quickly, now accounting for half of our revenue, and we’re continuing to invest aggressively in this area. There are still a ton of exciting projects and challenges ahead, which also gives this role the potential to have significant impact.
At Hightouch , our engineering leaders serve as both active technical voices and strong people managers. The key outcomes we are looking for from this role include:

•
Product Development: Lead the team in roadmapping and executing successful development of significant features and products as required to drive the business forward. Uphold a high technical bar, while making pragmatic tradeoffs

•
Pace: Through a combination of leadership and technical expertise, improve the pace of execution of the team

•
Recruiting: Be responsible for growing the team, including identifying needs, deciding how to evaluate candidates, and ensuring we hire high impact team members

•
Reliability: Against the uphill battle of high growth/scale, up-level the team on reliability, resulting in fewer incidents, catching our own issues before our customers do, and a strong incident management hygiene

•
People: Foster growth of team members and ensure strong engagement and motivation

Some of the problems we’ll be working on include:

•
Data Warehouse Performance: We’re consistently pushing the limits of what data warehouses can handle in terms of speed, performance, and interactivity. We explore optimizations generally (e.g. optimizing queries, storing pre-computed state), as well as investigate warehouse-specific improvements.

•
Analytics and Experimentation: How can Hightouch help customers build segments and decide what data they want to sync? How can we facilitate experimentation to downstream tools, including tracking the performance of different audiences?

•
Real-time Audience Syncing: Our users are always interested in faster syncing and fresher data. As warehouses become more real-time and adopt technologies like CDC, we’re excited to explore real-time audience computation and syncing.

•
Generative AI: We’re continuously working on making the user experience of acting on data more seamless, and are optimistic generative AI can enhance user workflows.

What We Offer
We are looking for talented, intellectually curious, and motivated individuals who are interested in tackling the problems above. This is a senior role, but we focus on impact and potential for growth more than years of experience. The salary range for this position is $220,000 - $400,000 USD per year,

About the role:

 

As Head of Payment Operations, you will be responsible for building and scaling Shift's payment operations function. You will play a key role in reducing regulatory, reputational, and fraud risk to the business and lead the team that manages payment operations on an ongoing basis. The initial focus will be on Direct Entry and NPP, but the role’s scope will expand alongside Shift’s growing payments product offering, including future rails and methods such as card issuing, BPAY, or PayTo, as well as the related vendor and infrastructure relationships.

 

What you'll do:

- Establish and maintain payment operations policies, procedures, and controls to meet regulatory expectations, embedding a governance framework within operations.

- Oversee SLAs for vendors, payment infrastructure, and processing partners in partnership with Product and Line 2 Risk, ensuring performance and risk obligations are met.

- Define and embed a performance framework using KPIs, data, and client insights to drive accountability and continuous improvement.

- Manage operational incidents for payment processing and fraud events, driving root cause analysis and response.

- Act as the business’ primary point of engagement for payment operations, educating stakeholders across Product, Risk, Customer Service, and executive leadership.

- Report on payment operations performance, risk posture, and incident trends to the Director of Operations and SLT as required.

 

What you'll bring:

 

- Demonstrated experience establishing or embedding payment operations capabilities, including people leadership, policy, and governance within regulated financial services.

- Expertise in Direct Entry and NPP payment rails, fraud monitoring, and disputes/chargebacks processes.

- Strong regulatory fluency and ability to translate requirements into operational controls.

- Experience managing vendors, service level agreements, or managed service providers in a payments or financial services context preferred.

- Proven people leadership skills, including experience building teams from a low base.

- Financial services industry experience.

- Skills in process mapping and optimisation, customer journey analysis, requirements definition, and data-led analysis.

- Experience in options analysis, business case development, stakeholder management, and executive communication.

title: Head of UK Customer Delivery
description:
Head of UK Customer Delivery
About Lyrebird

Lyrebird Health is building a category defining healthcare platform used daily by thousands of clinicians across the UK.
Today, it is the most widely deployed clinical ambient AI platform in the NHS, scaling nationally on the strength of exceptional real world delivery and reference-led growth.
Clinicians rely on the product in environments where errors are costly and time is scarce. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load and delivering durable impact at scale.
Commercial traction is accelerating across the NHS. Exceptional implementation is not a downstream support function. It is our primary growth engine.
The Role
This role owns customer delivery across the entire UK.
You will build, lead and scale the UK delivery engine from the ground up, defining the national delivery standards and operating model that regional leads execute against.
Every trust must have an exceptional experience. Every rollout should be reference worthy, and every clinician interaction must reinforce trust in the product.
This is a foundational leadership role with executive backing to enforce standards and build the function properly. You will franchise our delivery model into the UK, establish the systems that define excellence, and create a delivery engine capable of scaling across a national health system. The engine you build must strengthen with scale, delivering an increasingly exceptional experience as we expand to 50, 100 and ultimately every NHS trust.
What you'll do

• Own every UK implementation end to end, from signature to scaled adoption

• Design and operationalise the UK delivery model

• Define governance, reporting frameworks and escalation structures

• Build and lead a high performance implementation function

• Establish customer engagement standards across demos, training, go live and support

• Ensure every rollout is structured, measurable and reference worthy

• Operationalise high fidelity adoption visibility across trusts, departments and clinicians

• Partner closely with Commercial to ensure pilots convert into long term wins

What you'll bring

• Significant experience leading large scale NHS deployments supplier side

• Experience running 10+ concurrent trust rollouts

• Proven record of building greenfield delivery functions into scalable operations

• Deep quantitative orientation with the ability to build early warning systems and adoption dashboards

• Strong understanding of NHS politics, procurement and stakeholder dynamics

• History of successful deployments recognised as reference accounts

• Direct, precise communication style

• High ownership mindset and operational discipline

Why This Role Matters
In the NHS, the best pipeline builder is a well run implementation.
Exceptional delivery creates reference accounts, and reference accounts drive sustained momentum across the NHS. This role defines that engine for the UK.
The standard set here will shape how Lyrebird scales nationally and influence what NHS trusts expect from us as a partner.
For the right leader, this is an opportunity to define how a category defining healthcare company scales across a national health system.
At Lyrebird, we don’t just write code - we help shape the future of the human experience.
If you want to pioneer, to create, and to see your work touch lives directly, we’d love to hear from you.
We’re building a team that reflects the diversity of the people who’ll benefit from our work. We want Lyrebird to be a place where everyone feels safe, supported, and able to thrive. If you’re from an underrepresented background in tech, we especially encourage you to apply - even if you don’t meet every single requirement.

The best people in this seat are as comfortable running a cold outbound motion as they are sitting with an existing customer six months before renewal, understanding where their usage is headed and what it will take to expand.

You are a hunter and a builder. You enjoy creating new relationships and deepening existing ones. You're all about working hard, supporting one another, ideating nonstop, and having a lot of fun while doing it.

InfluxDB is a purpose-built time series database used by engineering, platform, DevOps, SRE, and IoT teams to handle high-volume telemetry data. You'll be selling to technical buyers, which means the strongest AEs on this team are curious, consultative, and willing to get into the substance of a customer's architecture and problem.

What you’ll be doing:

New Business

- Owning the full sales cycle for new logos in North America Commercial - prospecting, discovery, scoping, POC, negotiation, and close

- Building and sustaining your own pipeline through cold calling, outbound email, LinkedIn, account research, inbound follow-up, and partner activity

- Running strong discovery: understanding the technical use case, the business impact, the buying process, the stakeholders, and what success looks like

- Understanding the competitive landscape - including open source alternatives - and positioning InfluxData to win

- Partnering with Sales Engineering to scope and run technical evaluations and POCs

Renewals & Expansions

- Owning renewal outcomes across a book of approximately 40 existing accounts, including forecast accuracy on every renewal in your territory

- Engaging renewals early - well ahead of the contract date - to understand usage trends, changes in the customer's environment, budget cycle, and stakeholder changes

- Identifying and closing expansion: new use cases, new teams and divisions, increased capacity, and upgrades

- Building multi-threaded relationships across your accounts so the relationship does not sit with a single champion

- Spotting and escalating retention risk early, and working with Customer Success and Support to resolve it before it reaches the renewal conversation

- Conducting regular check-ins and business reviews with your accounts to keep value visible

Across the Whole Territory

- Building trust and credibility, both internally and with prospects and customers, from engineering to executive stakeholders

- Keeping opportunity detail, next steps, renewal dates, and forecast accurate in Salesforce

- Forecasting and managing your sales activity and pipeline to meet revenue targets and company goals

- Meeting or exceeding monthly targets and quarterly quota across both new business and renewal/expansion

- 1+ years of quota-carrying sales experience selling data solutions, SaaS, PaaS, developer tools, or cloud infrastructure

- Experience selling into commercial and mid-market organizations

- Experience managing accounts post-close through annual renewal cycles, with responsibility for retention and growth

title: Associate Project Manager, Program Management Office
description:
The Associate Project Manager is a generalist member of the PMO supporting a large federal facilities program delivered across multiple sites and task orders. You will work across PMO functions, including schedule, risk, change control, reporting, and deliverable review, and you will be deployed where the program needs support most, including site level work and phase gate reviews. You will operate with oversight from the PMO Director and senior project managers and may lead smaller scopes independently as you build experience.

This is a remote role on Eastern Time with travel to program sites as required. Candidates must be US citizens able to obtain a public trust and security clearance.
What you will do
- Support senior project managers across active task orders with planning, scheduling, procurement coordination, quality, and risk from initiation through closeout.
- Maintain site level risk registers and change control logs, confirm every entry has an owner and a mitigation, and prepare inputs for weekly program risk reviews.
- Track progress against approved baselines, report status and variances, and draft corrective action plans for review.
- Support deliverable reviews and phase gate checkpoints, including coordinating technical reviewers, tracking comments to closure, and confirming deliverables meet contract requirements before submission to the client.
- Prepare and maintain project documentation in accordance with program governance and client requirements, and support the transition of project data into the program's systems, including Power BI and Kahua.
- Identify work requested outside current contract scope and route it through the change control process.
- Step into a needs package or site team on short notice to cover gaps, coordinate with field staff, and report back to the PMO.
- Coordinate with client and partner counterparts to keep submissions, approvals, and reporting aligned.
- Model behaviors consistent with CBRE RISE values. Other duties as assigned.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent related experience.

• Two or more years supporting projects in a federal, infrastructure, facilities, or construction environment. Experience on a federal program with multiple task orders is strongly preferred.

• Working knowledge of schedule, risk, and change control fundamentals and the ability to apply them without detailed direction.

• Ability to read technical drawings and specifications well enough to support deliverable and site reviews.

• Strong written communication, with the ability to turn field and technical information into clear status for leadership.

• Comfort working across organizational boundaries with client, partner, and subcontractor staff.

• Ability to travel to program sites

Preferred

• CAPM or PMP.

• Experience with Power BI, Kahua, or similar project information systems.

• Prior exposure to FAA, DoD, or other federal facilities programs.

• Familiarity with earned value or level of effort contract tracking.

The salary range for this full-time role is $100K - $125K per year. Ranges are determined by role and level and represent a good faith effort to provide a fair and equitable salary. title: 2027 Summer Intern, MS/PhD, Software Engineer, Sys Intel & Machine Learning
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Software Engineering builds the brains of Waymo's fully autonomous driving technology. Our software allows the Waymo Driver to perceive the world around it, make the right decision for every situation, and deliver people safely to their destinations. We think deeply and solve complex technical challenges in areas like robotics, perception, decision-making and deep learning, while collaborating with hardware and systems engineers. If you’re a software engineer or researcher who’s curious and passionate about Level 4 autonomous driving, we'd like to meet you. 

The subteam for this role will be:

The Model Optimization & ML Runtime team (within Smart Perception / Machine Learning) is responsible for maximizing the capability, efficiency, and hardware performance of Waymo's cutting-edge perception and foundation models. We bridge the gap between large-scale multi-task ML research (Vision Transformer backbones, 30+ perception heads, multi-sensor fusion) and real-time onboard vehicle deployment across custom automotive accelerators, developing core optimization frameworks (parameter-efficient fine-tuning, quantization, compilation, and quantization-aware training) that power the autonomous Waymo Driver.

Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. • Design, implement, and benchmark parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA / QLoRA) modules in JAX/Flax for multi-task Vision Transformer backbones

• Develop dual-level distillation pipelines (intermediate feature matching and task-head logit distillation) to mitigate multi-task regressions during large-scale data scaling

• Collaborate with model optimization, quantization, and latency teams to validate static weight folding and low-precision quantization, ensuring zero latency overhead on onboard compute platforms

• Conduct extensive empirical ablations and evaluate perception metrics on large-scale autonomous driving datasets across diverse geographic domains

You have:

• Currently pursuing a PhD or Master's in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related technical field

• Strong software engineering and deep learning development skills in Python and modern frameworks (JAX, Flax, PyTorch, or TensorFlow)

• Solid theoretical understanding and hands-on experience with deep learning foundation models, Transformer architectures, and multi-task learning

• Experience with model compression, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA, QLoRA, adapters), or quantization and knowledge distillation techniques

We prefer:

• Publication record at top-tier computer vision or machine learning conferences (e.g., CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR)

• Hands-on experience with model quantization (PTQ, QAT, INT8/INT4/MX4), low-precision numerics, or hardware-aware model optimization

• Experience training and scaling large vision backbones or multi-modal models on distributed accelerator clusters (TPUs / GPUs)

title: Senior Creative Producer (Fixed-term Employment)
Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) - Grand Junction, CO
description:
Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $62 K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.

• Inclusive, socially responsib

description:

Remote | Full-time
We are looking for a talented Front-End Engineer to build and maintain cutting-edge Web3 applications that empower users within our ecosystem. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to create highly interactive and seamless user interfaces that align with our product vision and business objectives.
Responsibilities

• Develop pixel-perfect and UX-optimized Web3 applications using TypeScript and Next.js.

• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define, prioritize, and implement features that meet both user and business needs.

• Ensure components are functional, intuitive, performant, and mobile-responsive.

• Maintain high-quality code standards, including efficient documentation and testing.

Requirements

• 2+ years of experience in frontend engineering, with a strong command of TypeScript and React.

• Solid experience working in Web3, with proficiency in Web3 libraries such as ethers.js, wagmi, and viem.

• Experience in building and maintaining production-grade SDKs, APIs, or systems at scale.

• A passion for creating elegant, user-friendly, and performant interfaces that empower users in the Web3 space.

Personal

• Highly self-motivated/self-driven

• Insatiably hungry to learn and grow

• Fluent in English

• Highly reliable/Ability to meet deadlines ahead of time

• Focus on solutions mentality!

• Comfortable with an adaptive fast-paced startup environment.

• Ability to work in a diverse multi-disciplinary team.

• Sense of humour is a plus!

What we offer:

• Work with some of the most experienced people in the space from the team and across the best minds and projects in the ecosystem.

• You’ll never be bored but don’t burn out. Staying healthy and taking the time to relax and enjoy quality time away from work when needed. Play games, chill out, live long and prosper 🖖.

• We’ll acknowledge your contribution with competitive compensation.

About Zuzalu.City:
We are building an easy-to-use interface that serves as a collective operation system that connects users to decentralised, open-sourced and autonomous applications that are empowered with privacy choices for a community when it comes to coordination, contribution and collaboration.
This is an opportunity to join a community-driven public goods project. We are focused on building and maintaining an MVP team with sustainable development in mind. As part of our approach, we plan to offer stable work bounties and encourage community governance to ensure alignment with our mission and goals.
About Ethereum Community Fund :
We are an early-stage project currently building the Alpha, with a mission of creating an inclusive destination bwhere users can publish, discover, contribute, share and fund blockchain development projects focusing on Web3 technology. lnformation about projects and interests in projects are focused into a unified, open and user-friendly platform and all information is curated and governed by the platform community.
You will be working with a competent, fun and inclusive team based across different time zones, from different backgrounds and nationalities, dedicated to the development and growth of the community platform and Web3 tech.
